criterion: retained-data disposal at the end of a retention lifetime
outcome: After a profile's retention expiry the shopper object retains no grant naming the subject or session: the grant-authority record may remain as the barrier that keeps a legacy writer out, but its grants map is empty.
witness: src/durable-objects/ShopperReflex.ts:1469-1471 (the retention branch deletes only affinity, pipeline and audienceOwner and never runs eraseWithBarrier); src/retention.ts:24-25, :88-92 (a policy lifetime disposes the record it covers); BASE-1b reviewer probe P5 (a grant naming the subject and session survives the retention erasure). Document 35 §5 W06·G0: "Server-enforced deletion epoch/replay barrier prevents stale-cookie … resurrection" and "Retention and physical progress must be tested" — a grant naming the subject and session is exactly the stale material the barrier must not leave behind.
declared_from: src/reflex/shopperReflex.test.ts > alarm — lazy re-evaluation, exits pushed, retention deleteAll > retention: idle past N days with no sockets → storage.deleteAll()
residual: The same defect is measured a second time by src/reflex/shopperReflex.consent.test.ts 'W05.02 … honors withdrawal in serialized socket actions and pending alarms without skipping retention cleanup', which is left unwrapped and RED on the same assertion.

criterion: explicit consent governs every served personalization surface
outcome: The sort route validates the Durable Object consent envelope before it returns a ranked receipt: a reply that is not ok, carries no consent, or carries a consent that is not two real booleans with a live explicit instruction is refused before any receipt; and a real object whose stored choice is absent or refuses personalization contributes no vector, so the receipt scores 0 with no drivers while a consenting object's vector does contribute.
witness: src/routes/sort.ts:79-88 (the envelope check and the personalizes() gate on the DO host); src/content/consent.ts:139-152, :176 (absence and a bare boolean grant nothing; only a live explicit instruction personalizes); settled decision D06-W05. src/durable-objects/ShopperReflex.ts:648 (the object side of the host leg: `if (!personalizes(consent)) return json({ ok: true, consent, affinity: null, surface })` — the operative line, since the route gate at sort.ts:88 can be removed with the host leg still green).
residual: Measured GREEN-AT-SPEC at c0973ad+rework: the engine already refuses all six malformed envelopes and already withholds the vector from an absent or refusing choice.
